Finishing a reload grants 'SUROS Harmony' for 6 seconds, providing 30? Handling and ?% Flinch Resistance. The buff stays on that weapon through stowing.

Weapons with SUROS Synergy equipped and <yellow SUROS Regime /> also gain 15 Range. The Range benefit's timer begins when the reload animation allows you to fire, rather than when the Magazine is refilled.

// Handling and Flinch Resistance are uncertain. The source does not define whether the SUROS refresh exception covers only SUROS Synergy and SUROS Regime or other SUROS weapons as well.

source.text:
4 Piece | Suros Harmony

Upon finishing a reload:
SUROS Harmony | +30? Handling and ?% Flinch Resist for 6 seconds.
Weapons that have the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait equipped, as well as SUROS Regime are additionally granted +15 Range. 
For some reason, the +Range benefit's timer begins only once you are able to shoot in the reload animation instead of when the ammo is refilled.

SUROS Harmony persists through stow, but only on the weapon that it was triggered on. 
Can be refreshed by retriggering the buff unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao.
